newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA Q1 INDUSTRIAL SALES FALL 16.4 PCT YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA Q1 INDUSTRIAL SALES FALL 16.4 PCT YR/YR.

text.p: Industrial sales of Bulgaria'a
state and private sectors in the first quarter fell a real 16.4
percent from the same period of 1996 to 2,708.8 billion levs at
current prices, the National Statistics Institute (NSI) said.
Comparative figures for sales in the first quarter of last
year against the first three months of 1995 were not
immediately available.
Sales of the state industrial sector alone totalled 2,230.9
billion levs in the first quarter, down a real 18.5 percent
year on year from the same period of 1996.
Sales of the private industrial sector fell a real 5.8
percent year on year in the first three months to 477.9 billion
levs at current prices.
Sales of the state and the private sectors in March
amounted to 1,156.3 billion levs at current prices, down a real
21.9 percent from the same month last year.
State industrial sales alone fell a real 24.6 percent in
March against the same month last year to 948.6 billion levs at
current prices after declining a real 24.2 percent year on year
in February.
Sales from the private industrial sector fell a real 8.5
percent in March year on year to 207.7 billion levs at current
prices.
